15061.d: The Kharazi Jungle is an area south of Shilo Village on Karamja.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• When travelling from Shilo Village, players should stand north of the bush just south-west of the city and then cut two bushes to enter the jungle.
• The fairy ring CJS can be used to teleport to the area. It must first be restored with 5 bittercap mushrooms before travelling to or from it.
• A juju teleport spiritbag or witchdoctor mask can teleport the player to the nearby Herblore Habitat. The player can then reach the jungle by climbing over the vine to the north, heading west along the river, and hacking through the dense jungle to the south.
• Casting the Western Kharazi Jungle Teleport while on the Lunar spellbook will teleport you to the western side of the Kharazi jungle, a short distance west of the small pool located in the center & south-west of the village past the dense forests. This spell requires level 81 Magic and 3 astral runes, 2 law runes and 1 time rune to cast.

15076.d: The Kharidian Desert is an expansive region located south of the nations of Misthalin and Morytania.

gt.heading: Transportation
gt.text:
The main form of transportation in the desert is by Magic carpet. They can take the player to a variety of places in the desert, such as: 

# Al Kharid (south of Shantay Pass)
# North Pollnivneach
# South Pollnivneach
# Nardah
# Bedabin Camp
# Uzer (requires The Golem)
# Monkey colony (requires Do No Evil)
# Menaphos (requires Icthlarin's Little Helper)
# Sophanem (requires Icthlarin's Little Helper)

The normal cost of such travel is roughly 200 coins. However, doing the Rogue Trader activity or wearing the activated ring of Charos will decrease the price to 100 coins, and combining them both lowers it to 75 coins.

There are also several fairy rings located in the desert.

Wearing armour of any kind is not advisable, as due to its metallic nature the player will overheat faster and thus use up their supply of water quicker.

15118.d: Killerwatts are Slayer monsters that require level 37 Slayer to kill.
15118.ex:
Idle: A ball of electrical energy.

In combat: An angry electrical shock!

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Killerwatts can be found on the Killerwatt plane, by stepping through the interdimensional rift on the top floor of Draynor Manor. This area has flashing lights, and Oddenstein will warn players about this in case they are prone to epileptic seizures. Draynor Manor can be reached easily by going north after teleporting to Draynor via the Draynor lodestone.

During the Enlightened Journey quest, it was revealed by the balloon travelling screen that killerwatts inhabit clouds. However, players cannot engage them in battle there.

Players cannot use the dwarf multicannon in the Killerwatt plane.

15127.d: The King Black Dragon (named Shakorexis by Hannibus) is an enormous, three-headed black dragon.
15127.ex: Was the biggest, meanest dragon around.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
There are two artefacts that send players into the King Black Dragon's Lair. Note that the lair itself is not considered part of the Wilderness. Exiting from the King Black Dragon's lair that is located in the Wilderness while opted into PvP does not give the player a Wilderness warning prompt about being opted into PvP.
• There is a ladder in level 42 of the Wilderness () guarded by glacor (only in members worlds), leading to a small area within the Lava Maze Dungeon with aggressive poison spiders. Climbing over a small boulder enters a one-square safe area where you can use the artefact to access the lair. Entering the lair with this method will grant players a 10% damage boost against the King Black Dragon. The Level 44 Wilderness Obelisk may be useful in reaching it. Darren is just outside for bank access.
• There is a safe artefact north-west of the Edgeville lodestone; however, using this artefact to enter will not grant players the damage boost the way using the Wilderness one does.
• Players may also use the War's Retreat boss portal, which can be attuned to teleport next to the Edgeville artefact. The boss must have been defeated previously before it can be a portal option. Once a player has got a total of 10 boss kills, they can unlock the War's Retreat Teleport to quickly reach it.
